Question: Assalamualaikum Q-A PERSONS NAME IS MUHAMMADHALEEM IS THE NAME PERMISSIBLE TO KEEP?OR SHOULD IT BE CHANGED? Q2-I HEARD THAT THE MEANING OF THE NAME UWAIS IS WOLF (BHERYA)IS THIS TRUE? AND SHOULD THE NAME BE CHANGED? Q3-WHAT DOES THE NAME WAQQAS MEAN?IS IT OK TO KEEP THE NAME WAQQAS? Answer ID: 10343 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 193/193=M/1429) (1) Muhammad Haleem is correct name, but Abdul Haleem is better. (2) It is right that Uwais means: wolf. There was a famous Tabi?ee with the same name; therefore keeping the name as Uwais is correct. (3) Waqqas means: net to prey birds, this name is also correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
